bull.b: A large cash balance and explicit runway into H2 2028 materially reduces near-term financing pressure and gives management time to execute registrational work on Varseta‑M, advance combinations and CX‑801, and prioritize capital allocation without forcing immediate dilution.

An enlarged, high-value partnership with Regeneron validates the Probody platform, creates substantial non-dilutive milestone potential, and diversifies future revenue streams; structural partner support also helps derisk development and commercialisation paths over the medium term.

Durable clinical efficacy materially above existing late-line standards increases likelihood of a successful registrational program, supports a differentiated positioning for an EpCAM ADC, and underpins potential for label expansion and higher commercial value if safety/tolerability are managed.

bear.b: Ongoing negative operating and free cash flow demonstrates the company is not self-funding R&D; sustaining multiple clinical programs will continue to consume cash and could require future financings or milestone reliance, pressuring shareholder dilution and strategic flexibility.

Revenue is lumpy and dependent on collaboration milestones rather than recurring product sales, producing large year-over-year swings that complicate forecasting and increase reliance on partner payments or equity raises to fund operations absent commercialized products.

Safety concerns and unresolved dose selection create structural regulatory and commercial risk: if Grade 3 events or tolerability prevent selecting an optimal registrational dose, trial design, label restrictions and physician uptake could be materially impaired even if efficacy remains strong.
